finding.sequence_description: OIDC enterprise SSO: attempt to authenticate with an ID token that uses an attacker-controlled kid (JWKS key selection confusion). Broker must reject tokens not verifiable under the configured IdP trust anchor.
finding.description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_kid_injection_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_kid_injection_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Broker accepted a token with attacker-controlled kid/untrusted signing key selection (JWKS kid confusion) instead of enforcing configured IdP trust anchor.

sequence.description: OIDC enterprise SSO: attempt to authenticate with an ID token that uses an attacker-controlled kid (JWKS key selection confusion). Broker must reject tokens not verifiable under the configured IdP trust anchor.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I1: The RP must verify the exact ID token signature under the configured IdP JWKS/trust policy; attacker-controlled kid must not cause acceptance of an untrusted signing key.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Control password login failed; cannot interpret subsequent proof-integrity results.
Broker accepted a token with attacker-controlled kid/untrusted signing key selection (JWKS kid confusion) instead of enforcing configured IdP trust anchor.

captured_state.api_pattern: Logto Management API uses /api/ prefix. User CRUD: /api/users. SSO connectors: /api/sso-connectors. Applications: /api/applications.
captured_state.login_strategy: For user authentication, use login_with_password with username and password. The executor handles the multi-step OIDC Experience API flow transparently. For machine/service tokens, use login_with_jwt
captured_state.app_types: Logto application types: Native, SPA, Traditional, MachineToMachine, Protected, SAML. Do NOT use TraditionalWeb or WebApp — use 'Traditional'.
captured_state.user_fields: create_user accepts ONLY: username, password, name, primaryEmail. Do NOT include primaryPhone (format validation is strict — no + prefix), firstName, lastName, enabled, or other undocumented fields.
captured_state.sso_connector_setup_note: SSO connectors (OIDC and SAML) are pre-configured pointing to a mock IdP. The mock IdP is controllable: POST /admin/set-claims to change identity attributes (sub, email, name, groups, email_verified).

finding.sequence_description: OIDC enterprise SSO nonce bypass: attempt OIDC SSO login where IdP omits nonce in id_token; RP must reject when nonce was sent.
finding.description: OIDC SSO verify accepted id_token without nonce claim. The mock IdP omits nonce by default; per OIDC Core 3.1.3.7 §11, the RP must reject id_tokens with missing nonce when nonce was sent in the authorization request. Nonce validation bypassed.

sequence.description: OIDC enterprise SSO nonce bypass: attempt OIDC SSO login where IdP omits nonce in id_token; RP must reject when nonce was sent.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I2: OIDC SSO callback artifacts must be bound to the original auth request via nonce; an id_token missing nonce must be rejected when nonce was used.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Control failed: baseline password login did not succeed; cannot interpret OIDC SSO nonce enforcement.
OIDC SSO accepted id_token without nonce even though nonce should be required (OIDC Core 3.1.3.7 §11).
Test isolation failure: victim password identity and attacker OIDC SSO identity collapsed; nonce-bypass result may be confounded.

finding.sequence_description: MFA coherence across auth methods: enable MFA factors on a victim user, confirm password login is blocked/challenged, then attempt SAML SSO login asserting the same email. If SAML login succeeds without MFA, flow coherence is violated (step skipping via alternate binding path).
finding.description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_saml_as_victim_login_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_saml_as_victim_login_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SAML SSO login succeeded for an MFA-enabled account without completing MFA (alternate binding path skipped required step).

sequence.description: MFA coherence across auth methods: enable MFA factors on a victim user, confirm password login is blocked/challenged, then attempt SAML SSO login asserting the same email. If SAML login succeeds without MFA, flow coherence is violated (step skipping via alternate binding path).
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I3: MFA requirements must be enforced consistently for the same account across authentication methods; SAML SSO must not bypass MFA-bound steps for an MFA-enabled user.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Password login succeeded (or did not challenge) despite MFA being enabled; cannot validate MFA coherence across methods.
SAML SSO login succeeded for an MFA-enabled account without completing MFA (alternate binding path skipped required step).

finding.sequence_description: Unverified-email account linking via enterprise SSO (SAML connector): attacker claims victim email with email_verified=false; platform must not map attacker to victim account.
finding.description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_sso_entity_id != user_victim_pwd_entity_id
Evaluation: user_attacker_sso_entity_id='elg76viwfmvv' != 'elg76viwfmvv' → False
Implication: Attacker SSO principal (unverified email) was mapped to victim's downstream identity (account takeover via unverified email linking)

sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I4: A security-distinct upstream principal (attacker sub) must not be mapped to the victim's downstream subject solely due to an unverified matching email.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Baseline failed: mechanism cannot distinguish principals

Evaluation: user_saml_nocond_attack_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted a SAML assertion without Conditions (no audience/time bounds), enabling authorization not bound to upstream intent/policy.

finding.sequence_description: SAML brokered login authorization binding: attempt to authenticate with a forged SAMLResponse using a wrong IdP entity ID (Issuer) to see if Logto accepts assertions from an untrusted issuer (would over-grant a session). Includes a control SAML login first.
finding.description:
Assertion FAILED: user_saml_wrong_issuer_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_saml_wrong_issuer_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Logto accepted a SAML assertion with an untrusted/incorrect Issuer, granting a session beyond BrokerPolicy trust configuration (authorization binding failure).

sequence.description: SAML brokered login authorization binding: attempt to authenticate with a forged SAMLResponse using a wrong IdP entity ID (Issuer) to see if Logto accepts assertions from an untrusted issuer (would over-grant a session). Includes a control SAML login first.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I5: A session must only be granted when upstream intent matches BrokerPolicy(config) trust configuration; assertions from an untrusted Issuer must be rejected (no authorization grant).

oracle_checks.violation_description: Control SAML login did not succeed; cannot interpret mutated Issuer test.
Logto accepted a SAML assertion with an untrusted/incorrect Issuer, granting a session beyond BrokerPolicy trust configuration (authorization binding failure).
